text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The 4th Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting 
was... Fair to call it a success!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
While some noted that facility 
construction and leveling were a bit 
lacking, they still praised it as a 
wonderful training facility!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now then— The next Tracen Island Review 
will be the last one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Development and construction wrap up 
at the end of June! Tracen Island is 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And for the next six months or so after 
that! We shall use that time to promote 
Tracen Island!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we have to demonstrate the utility 
of this island we built to the higher-ups.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If Tracen Island is deemed useless during 
this period, running the island properly 
will likely be out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Well, worst-case scenario, we tear it 
down!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, at the briefing 
session they said that if it's not 
completed within the period, it'll be torn 
down.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even if I manage to complete it... It's 
meaningless if it isn't put to use, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This project is, strictly speaking, a 
trial. It is only natural that we must 
prove its usefulness in terms of 
maintenance and operation.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Well, none of that matters right now! 
What we should be thinking about is the 
next final evaluation meeting!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
We must draw up a construction plan, 
gather testers, and make this place even 
better!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Besides, with the island in its current 
state, we can build even higher-level 
facilities! Let's get fired up and tackle 
this with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 4th Tracen Island Evaluation 
concluded! Heading into the final 
evaluation, first comes drafting the 
construction plan!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Ahh, so sleepy... I totally 
overdid it yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And—the Tucker Brine... of Tracen 
Island... was...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Really...? Isn't that pretty bad?
